:::{#def-mode}
#### Mode of a random variable

Let $X$ be a [random variable](#def-random-variable)
with [density](#def-pdf) or [mass function](#def-pmf) $f$.
A **mode** of $X$ is an element of the [argmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra.html#def-argmax) of $f$ over the [range](#def-range) of $X$:

$$x^* \in \argmax_{x \in \rangef{X}} f(x).$$

:::
